<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_snp_manager_su_0_follow_up_action</collection><condition>current.action_type.changes()</condition><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>FUA – store Action Type value</name><order>90</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * The approval flow copies Action type from the Follow-up Template with a data pill, and Flow Designer
 * passes the choice label ("Knowledge transfer") instead of the value (knowledge_transfer).
 * A label is not a valid choice, so the form and list show it in blue. Convert it back to the value.
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    var type = current.getValue('action_type');
    if (!type)
        return;

    var choice = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
    choice.addQuery('name', current.getTableName());
    choice.addQuery('element', 'action_type');
    choice.addQuery('value', type);
    choice.setLimit(1);
    choice.query();
    if (choice.hasNext())
        return; // already a valid value

    choice = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
    choice.addQuery('name', current.getTableName());
    choice.addQuery('element', 'action_type');
    choice.addQuery('label', type);
    choice.setLimit(1);
    choice.query();
    if (choice.next())
        current.setValue('action_type', choice.getValue('value'));
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>pratiksha.bhandavale</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-18 12:57:57</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>afdd40c91bc4d310b2f70fa0604bcbcd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>FUA – store Action Type value</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Manager Support Hub" source="x_snp_manager_su_0">8e0e1a231b730750b2f70fa0604bcb0f</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Manager Support Hub">8e0e1a231b730750b2f70fa0604bcb0f</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_afdd40c91bc4d310b2f70fa0604bcbcd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>pratiksha.bhandavale</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-18 12:57:57</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=afdd40c91bc4d310b2f70fa0604bcbcd"/></record_update>
